• Completely lower the hydraulic jack and remove the mounting for the handbrake and electro-hydraulic selection gearbox control levers.
• At the bench, undo the nuts (1a) and remove the lever mounting (1b).
• Undo the bolts (1a) and remove the handbrake lever assembly (1b).

Refitting

Removing
  • Place the handbrake lever assembly on the mounting and secure it using the bolts.
  • Place the lever mounting back in its housing and fasten it using the nuts.
  • Place the mounting for the handbrake and electro-hydraulic selection gearbox control levers back in position using a hydraulic jack.
  • Place the exhaust pipe side heat shields back in their housings.
  • Tighten the bolts and the nuts complete with plates fastening the mounting for the handbrake and electro-hydraulic selection gearbox control levers.
  • Remove the hydraulic jack from underneath the mounting for the handbrake and electro-hydraulic selection gearbox control levers.
  • Connect the handbrake cables to the bracket.
  • Op. 1076B24 INTERMEDIATE EXHAUST SILENCER - R + R
  • Op. 1076B30 FRONT EXHAUST SILENCER - R + R
  • Connect the electrical connection to the handbrake switch.
  • Op. 3380A04 HANDBRAKE - CHECK TRAVEL
  • Place the handbrake boot back in its housing.
  • Op. 2127A12 HAND LEVER OF MANUAL GEARBOX WITH HYDRAULIC SELECTION - R R
  • Op. 7040L37 GEAR LEVER PLATE - R R
  • Op. 7065C42 ASHTRAY (ONE) R+R
  • Place the trim in its housing on the tunnel cover.
  • Connect the negative battery terminal (-).
  • Remove the vehicle from the lift.
